newsitem.title: UK: Rentokil shares boosted by bargain-hunting.
newsitem.headline: Rentokil shares boosted by bargain-hunting.

text.p: Shares in Rentokil Initial Plc rose against the tide of a falling market on Monday, as bargain-hunters bought the stock after its recent decline, dealers said.
Shares in the business services group were 10p higher at 418-1/2 by 1535 GMT on volume of 3.3 million.
"The shares have come down a lot recently and when they fell to 400p that was an important level that got some people in to buy," one market-maker said.

Rentokil shares have slid from a high of 493 on February 12, with the company hit by market disappointment about its annual results. Dealers said there was good support for the stock below the 400p level.
